ety.text: Inherited from Proto-New Indo-Aryan *लडिक्क (laḍikka). Related to the lexicographically-attested Sanskrit लाडिक (lāḍika, “boy, servant”), लट्व (laṭva, “dancing boy”) लट (laṭa, “fool”), and thus may ultimately come from Sanskrit लट् (laṭ, “to act like a child”) + Middle Indo-Aryan -𑀓𑁆𑀓- (-kka-). Cognate to Awadhi लरिका (larikā), Assamese ল’ৰা (löra), Bhojpuri लईका (laīkā), Bengali লেড়কা (leṛoka).
Borrowed from Classical Persian شناخت (šināxt). Compare Punjabi ਸ਼ਨਾਖ਼ਤ (śanāxat) / شَناخت (śanāxt), Bengali শনাক্ত (śonakto).
